steps.name: the Mars Rover web application is open
the plateau size is set to "5 5"

elements.name: Rover moves forward and turns left

steps.name: I set the starting position to "1 2 N"
I send the commands "LMLMLMLMM"
I click the Execute button
the final position should be "1 3 N"

name: Mars Rover Movement
description:
As a NASA operator
  I want to send commands to a Mars Rover
  So that it can navigate the plateau

steps.name: the Mars Rover web application is open
the plateau size is set to "5 5"
I set the starting position to "1 2 N"
I send the commands "LMLMLMLMM"
I click the Execute button
the final position should be "1 3 N"
the Mars Rover web application is open
the plateau size is set to "5 5"
I set the starting position to "3 3 E"
I send the commands "MMRMMRMRRM"
I click the Execute button
the final position should be "5 1 E"

name: Multiple Rovers Navigation
description:
As a NASA operator
  I want to deploy multiple rovers sequentially
  So that I can explore different areas

elements.name: Verify GET request to InSight Mars Weather API

steps.name: the base URI is set to "https://api.nasa.gov"
I send a GET request to "/insight_weather/?api_key=DEMO_KEY&feedtype=json&ver=1.0"
